deadline.value: January 15 (Fall entry); late applications considered if openings remain. Year inferred for Fall 2027.
deadline.quote: January 15 (late applications will be considered if openings remain)

gre_subject.value: Not stated on the page checked

supervisor.value: Not stated on the page checked

funding.value: University-level statement: applicants are automatically considered for admission funding (TA, research stipend, scholarships) and notified in the offer if eligible; no guaranteed minimum stated on the pages checked
funding.quote: When submitting an application for admission to Carleton, students are automatically considered for funding and if eligible, will be notified in the Offer of Admission and Funding.

entry_route.value: An MSc is normally required; exceptional honours-BSc holders (A- average, significant research) may enter the Direct Entry PhD; MSc-to-PhD transfer possible
entry_route.quote: An M.Sc. in Physics or a closely related field is normally required for admission into the Ph.D. program. | Exceptional undergraduate students holding an honours B.Sc. in Physics or a closely related field, with a minimum A- average and significant research experience, may be considered for the Direct Entry Ph.D. program.

app_fee.quote: After you submit your application you will be required to pay the non-refundable application fee of C$125

fee_waiver.value: Graduate application fees are not waived
fee_waiver.quote: Application fees for graduate programs will not be waived

toefl_min.value: TOEFL iBT 86 (20 reading/listening, 22 speaking/writing) for tests before Jan 21, 2026; 4.5 overall on the new scale (5.0 writing); IELTS 6.5 (6.0 per band)
toefl_min.quote: For exams taken before January 21, 2026: | 86 (20 in reading and listening; 22 in speaking and writing) | 4.5 overall (minimum 5.0 in writing, 4.5 in reading, listening and speaking)

english_waiver.value: Exemption only for English-taught degrees from countries whose primary language is English (India does not qualify) or a recent Canadian degree; medium-of-instruction letters are explicitly not accepted
english_waiver.quote: presenting official certification (transcripts) that you have completed an undergraduate or graduate degree at a university in any country in which the primary language is English | Note: Letters from your universities stating the medium of instruction is English are not acceptable.

notes: PhD streams: Particle Physics and Medical Physics (CAMPEP-accredited), run jointly with uOttawa through the Ottawa-Carleton Institute for Physics. The department site (physics.carleton.ca) returned errors on every fetch, so supervisor and GRE policy could not be checked.
